spl_product_data_elements: MedPride Sterile Benzalkonium chloride WATER BENZALKONIUM CHLORIDE BENZALKONIUM
warnings: Warnings For external use only ■ flammable, keep away from fire or flame
do_not_use: Do not use ■ with electrocautery procedures ■ in the eyes, if contact occurs, flush eyes with water
stop_use: Stop use and ask a doctor if ■if irritation and redness develops. if condition persist consult your health practitioner.
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed contact a doctor or Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: Directions ■wipe the required site vigorously and discard
spl_unclassified_section: Other information ■ store at room temperature 15C-30C (59F-86F)
